newsitem.title: USA: TJX Cos. to sell Chadwick's of Boston for $300 million.
newsitem.headline: TJX Cos. to sell Chadwick's of Boston for $300 million.

text.p: TJX Cos. Inc. said Monday it has entered into a definitive agreement to sell its Chadwick's of Boston apparel catalogue unit to Brylane LP, a catalogue retailer of women's and men's special size apparel, for about $300 million.
TJX said it expects to report an estimated after-tax gain from the sale of $125 million, or $1.39 per share. The sale is expected to be completed in the fourth quarter.
The company said that if the sale proceeded on schedule, the gain would be posted in its fiscal fourth quarter.
The sale is being pursued in lieu of an earlier planned initial public offering of Chadwick's of Boston, a company spokesman said.
TJX's stock was up 12.5 cents at $42.875 on the New York Stock Exchange.
